name: app/toast
title: Toast
summary: The result of the last action (saved, signed out), carried across Post/Redirect/Get as a flash, in a polite live region. It stays until dismissed; dismissing needs no script.

props.name: flash
props.description: The message, or null for an empty live region.

behaviour: The live region is always rendered, so a message that arrives is announced.
Dismiss is a <label> for a hidden checkbox; checked, the toast hides.

keyboard: Tab to the dismiss checkbox; Space dismisses.
focus: The toast shows the `--ring` when its checkbox has keyboard focus.

theming.brandOverlay: None. Success is malachite and info cobalt, as status colours, in every brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: Full width less 16px gutters at the bottom on phones; bottom-right, at most 28rem, from sm.
contract:
contract
  slot is "toast-region"
  role is "status"
  label "Dismiss" min_height 44
  when default shows p "Saved."
  when empty slot is "toast-region"
end
